name: how-we-doing
description: A static profile of the US economy and all 50 states plus DC: GDP, income, taxes, crime and more.

scripts.fetch: npm run fetch:bea && npm run fetch:census && npm run fetch:bls && npm run fetch:fbi && npm run validate && npm run build
scripts.fetch:dry: node scripts/fetch-bea.mjs --dry-run && node scripts/fetch-census.mjs --dry-run && node scripts/fetch-bls.mjs --dry-run && node scripts/fetch-fbi.mjs --dry-run
scripts.test: node scripts/validate-data.mjs && node scripts/test-fetchers.mjs && node scripts/test-site.mjs
